summary: Batch #8 (Weekly Winner / Star of the Week + Global Search) tested end-to-end: all 10 backend pytest cases and every frontend flow passed. Backend GET /api/rewards returns correctly sorted week_leaderboard + star_of_week (Raj @ 125 pts) with a child (Aarav @ 36 pts incl. 8-pt chore completions) also present in the weekly board. GET /api/highlights/week exposes matching star_of_week alongside counts {posts,memories,wishes,loves} and memories list. GET /api/search is case-insensitive, scoped to caller's family, returns {members, memories, posts, chats}, and empty/blank q returns fully-empty result set. Frontend: Home 'home-search' icon opens /search; global-search-input debounces correctly; Priya returns 1 member + 1 direct chat; 'family' returns 2 memories + 1 post + 1 Family Chat; global-search-clear resets and re-shows hint; garbage query shows 'No results' state; taps route correctly to /member/, /timeline/, /post/, /chat/. Rewards screen renders gold crown STAR OF THE WEEK card (Raj + 125 stars + avatar), 5-row leaderboard, 3-day streak, 8 badges. Highlights screen renders STAR OF THE WEEK card plus 4 stat cards (Posts 1, Memories 8, Wishes 0, Loves 10) and new memories list.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~2484 lines; consider splitting into feature modules (rewards, search, chat, timeline, etc.) — mentioned in prior iterations, still applies.
compute_weekly_stars and /rewards duplicate the per-source point loop (posts/affections/timeline/wishes/chore_completions). Extract into a helper to keep them permanently in sync.
seed_data_creation: Used pre-seeded winner1786918036@fam.com (Sharma family). Also registered a throw-away second family in tests for cross-family leakage check.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Batch #8 complete. Fresh seeded winner account keeps Raj = Star of the Week (125 wk-pts) and Aarav has chore completions (36 wk-pts incl. 8-pt chores). Auth: welcome screen -> 'I already have an account' -> Log In button is around y≈383 in 390-wide viewport. First home visit shows an affection overlay 'Priya sent you Hug' — dismiss via 'Tap to close' before touching testIDs. Streak chip (testID home-streak) is the reliable way to navigate to /rewards. `page.goto('/rewards')` triggers a full reload that loses auth (401s); prefer in-app navigation.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found in Batch #8. Feature implementation is correct and consistent between /api/rewards and /api/highlights/week (shared compute_weekly_stars helper), and the /search endpoint properly scopes by family_id and hydrates chats via display_name.
